Hey Tracy!

I wanted to give you a quick heads up that I booked a call with Viktor Michael on March 26th at 1 PM CST. This lead actually came through our TLC email campaign, and when it first landed on my desk I immediately thought it might be a really interesting opportunity for collaboration rather than a traditional prospect.

They are not a med spa themselves, but they operate very much inside the aesthetics ecosystem. From what I can tell, they are in med spas regularly and have developed an aftercare product line specifically for post-injection care. Because of that, it felt like a natural overlap with what we are both doing in the industry. My first thought was that there could be a strategic partnership opportunity where all three of us could potentially support each other rather than approaching it as a standard client relationship.

With that in mind, I put together a proposal introducing the idea of a collaboration between them, AIA, and TLC. The angle I positioned was that they already have strong proximity to med spas through their aftercare line, while we bring the training, education, and growth systems side of the industry. If structured correctly, it could be a really nice ecosystem play where everyone benefits and it opens doors across multiple clinics.

I’m attaching the proposal I sent so you can see how I framed it. After you take a look, I’d love your thoughts. Do you want to join the call with me on the 26th so we can explore the opportunity together from the start, or would you prefer that I take the initial call, vet them a bit more, and then loop you in once we have a clearer sense of fit and potential?

Either way works for me. I just wanted to run it by you first since it could potentially be a really aligned partnership.

Let me know what you think!
